canonicalization.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; compact JSON payload, no terminal newline; actual LF only in domain
canonicalization.objectKeyOrder: ascending UTF-16 code units; exact schema keys are ASCII
canonicalization.arrayOrder: preserve input; reject unsorted inventories before serialization
canonicalization.strings: JSON.stringify escaping; raw non-ASCII scalar UTF-8, no NFC/NFD normalization, lone surrogates rejected
canonicalization.numbers: base10 safe integer only; -0 rejected before serializer
canonicalization.parse: Host storage reader: fatal UTF-8, no BOM, JSON.parse into untrusted value, reject unsupported scalars, canonical full-record reserialization must equal original decoded bytes before use, then exact schema/revision checks. This catches duplicate/escaped keys, whitespace and alternate encodings without a second JSON parser; writer-input object key permutation is allowed, stored byte permutation is not.
canonicalization.digest: sha256(domain UTF-8 + canonical payload UTF-8), lowercase hex
canonicalization.templateEncoding: Separate from Host record codec: exact SDK JSON.stringify(template) UTF-8; finite fractional V1 stat values preserved; see templateVectors

schema.integerRules: schemaVersion/forkBuild/compilerVersion positive safe integers, reject -0/fraction/nonfinite; schemaVersion=1
schema.stringRules: valid Unicode scalar sequence; no NUL/CR/LF in paths/argv; digest lowercase64hex, upstreamCommit lowercase40hex; packageName/version/pin and compiler compared to SDK expectations by consumer, not guessed from this fixture
schema.pathRules: absolute normalized release-contained paths, no dot/dotdot/empty component; assets relative under assetRoot; lexical vectors do not prove owner/symlink/inode/trust; installed release directory is version + hyphen + checksum first12hex per existing contracts saleskoAgentReleaseRelativePaths; fixed Salesko releasesRoot; bundle/binary/bun/launch-cwd suffixes exact
schema.graphRules: Type graph cycles print->print and print->runner->print are intentional. Actual delegation instances must consume depth from a trusted parent instance; runner->print executes the already-admitted delegation and does not charge depth twice. No edge from prepared. A config checksum is not a signature or a fresh budget admission.
schema.limitsRules: All four descendantPolicy limit fields explicitly Host-authored safe integers. maxDepth>=0; fanout/parallel/sessionCap>=1. No coercion, -0, fraction, null, omitted or unlimited sentinel. User effective values including grants must be <= each corresponding bound; exceeding any bound rejects, never clamps. Example 3/7/2/11 is synthetic, not a production default or approval of actual numerical limits.
schema.credentialRules: inheritsCredential is boolean true on these five model-execution edges. It permits only the parent lane already-declared credential source/names; never a new lookup/provider authority. Provider credential values are absent from config, fixtures and digest preimages. Existing shared credential exclusions remain unchanged. MCP projection always strips them.
schema.envNameAllowlistRules: Explicit sorted unique finite Host policy. No wildcard, credentials, lifecycle exemptions or loader injection names; all names must be in SDK supported vocabulary. Host may restrict delegation but cannot authorize new code loaders.
